title: Henselian neighborhood cohomology as an etale-neighborhood colimit
statement: Let X be an affine scheme, i : Z → X a closed immersion [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], Λ a commutative ring, J a sheaf of Λ-modules on the small etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and q a natural number. There exist a commutative ring A in the scheme universe, an ideal K with (A,K) henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], a morphism t : Spec A → X and an isomorphism e : Z ≅ Spec(A/K) with i = e followed by the quotient immersion and t. There exist a small filtered category I, schemes Y_a etale over X by v_a, a diagram H : I → Ab, and a colimit cocone c whose point is isomorphic to H^q(Spec A,t^*J_ab) and whose values are isomorphic to H^q(Y_a,v_a^*J_ab). The pullbacks and underlying abelian sheaves use [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and cohomology uses [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No torsion condition is assumed.

source.place: Affine case, construction of the henselization and second displayed equality; Tags 0A02 and 09YQ

proof.text: Choose the small directed ring-colimit presentation of the henselian neighborhood, including the closed-fibre triangle and compatible etale stage maps.

Construct the canonical cohomology diagram and its cocone for the underlying abelian sheaf. Apply the existing affine ring-colimit continuity theorem to its explicit arrow and leg equations. Transport the limit and stage groups through Sheaf.functorH applied to pullback_forget_modules_iso.

lean.statement:
theorem Etale.affine_closed_henselian_neighborhood_colimit
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (J : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ (A : Type u) (_ : CommRing A) (K : Ideal A) (_ : HenselianRing A K)
      (t : Spec (.of A) ⟶ X) (e : Z ≅ Spec (.of (A ⧸ K))),
      i = e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk K)) ≫ t ∧
      ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
        (Y : I → Scheme.{u}) (v : ∀ a, Y a ⟶ X),
        (∀ a, Etale (v a)) ∧
        ∃ (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (c : Cocone H),
          Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧
          Nonempty (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
            ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
              ((t)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj J)) q) ≅ c.pt) ∧
          ∀ a, Nonempty (H.obj a ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
            ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
              ((v a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj J)) q))
